invariants.rationale: map is dereferenced in map.getLayers(), so it must not be null.
map.getLayers() is iterated over in a for-each loop, so it must not be null.
beginRender() is called; beginRender must be a defined method (though in practice, this may refer to a method, but if it is a field, it should not be null).

endRender() is called; endRender must be a defined method (though in practice, this may be redundant if endRender is a method and not a field but is included for completeness if the field is present).
